scope.purpose: Track researched CPO prefixes that are not yet fully represented by exact tariff evidence in the staging catalog.

DE811.reason: Multiple exact Bosch station/EVSE prices are verifiable, but they materially vary across sites and connector types: examples include 0.38 EUR/kWh AC, 0.55 EUR/kWh DC and other sites with 0.45/0.65 EUR/kWh plus a post-45-minute time fee. A single Bosch network tariff would therefore be an unsafe extrapolation.
DE811.neededToComplete: Build an exact DE811 EVSE tariff map from Mobilithek/AFIR or public QR/payment station payloads, including per-EVSE energy price and any blocking/time component.

DEALL.reason: Official current Germany direct pricing is exact for the 350 kW (0.76 EUR/kWh) and 150 kW (0.66 EUR/kWh) product bands, but the official regular/50 kW band is only published as a 0.48-0.60 EUR/kWh range. Allego also publishes a Germany HPC overstay fee of 0.246 EUR/min after 45 minutes when charging has ended. The exact regular-band station price therefore cannot be assigned network-wide without a station/QR mapping.
DEALL.neededToComplete: Resolve Allego's public station/QR tariff payload or equivalent official station-level feed and attach the exact current direct tariff to every DEALL station/EVSE. Do not infer the exact 0.48-0.60 EUR/kWh regular-band value from power alone.

DECNT.reason: Official AFIR/Mobilithek publication discovery is implemented, but exact tariff-to-station/EVSE mapping is not yet exhaustive.
DECNT.neededToComplete: Resolve the official publication payload and attach each exact ad-hoc tariff to the corresponding station/EVSE without extrapolation.

DEENC.reason: enercity officially states that ad-hoc/FlexLaden current prices are shown at the station and that selected stations can use dynamic prices. SmartLaden also adds app-specific dynamic behavior and time-dependent blocking-fee rules. A national flat direct tariff would therefore be incorrect.
DEENC.neededToComplete: Resolve the current public payment/display or AFIR/Mobilithek station/EVSE price feed, including time validity and blocking rules, for all DEENC EVSEs.

DEESB.reason: ESB officially confirms QR/app/card activation and publishes its authenticated FLEX mobil card tariff, but that subscriber tariff is not the direct/ad-hoc tariff. A current station-level aggregator reports 0.49 EUR/kWh ad-hoc for its priced DEESB sample, yet that sample covers only 86 charge points versus 1,459 EVSEs represented by the V9 staging catalog. Network-wide exact pricing and blocking conditions therefore cannot be extrapolated.
DEESB.neededToComplete: Resolve the direct QR/card-payment tariff contract for every ESB station/EVSE via the public checkout, Ladenetz/Smartlab payload, Mobilithek/AFIR tariff feed, or equivalent verifiable station-level source, including any blocking or parking conditions.

DEHTL.reason: Exact station-level ad-hoc tariffs are verifiable for a subset of DEHTL, including 0.44, 0.52 and 0.55 EUR/kWh examples. The variation proves that a flat network tariff must not be inferred from one site.
DEHTL.neededToComplete: Harvest the exact tariff for every DEHTL EVSE from Mobilithek/Eco-Movement-derived open data or public QR/payment pages, preserving connector-specific energy and time/blocking components.

DEI2G.reason: At least one verifiable public inno2grid station-level ad-hoc tariff is now available (Areal Böhler Autowerk, Meerbusch: 0.49 EUR/kWh), while other inno2grid stations still report the direct ad-hoc price as unknown. A network-wide tariff therefore must not be extrapolated.
DEI2G.neededToComplete: Map the verified 0.49 EUR/kWh station to its exact DEI2G EVSEs, then obtain an official/public ad-hoc checkout, QR tariff endpoint, station-level CPO export, or equivalent verifiable exact price for every remaining DEI2G station/EVSE.

DEIOY.reason: IONITY's current Germany page exposes 0.72 EUR/kWh Direct and 0.68 EUR/kWh App as minimum prices, while the official July 2026 pricing explanation says Germany direct/ad-hoc can be up to 0.76 EUR/kWh and the applicable price is shown in the app or on the charger. Official support confirms a public QR/manual charger-selection flow at payment.ionity.eu. A single national tariff must therefore not be applied to all DEIOY EVSEs.
DEIOY.neededToComplete: Resolve a stable public station/EVSE identifier-to-price contract in payment.ionity.eu or another official station feed and capture the applicable exact direct tariff for every DEIOY EVSE.

DELVP.reason: Official LadeVerbundPlus pricing publishes the network energy component (ad-hoc 0.52 EUR/kWh AC and 0.62 EUR/kWh DC), but blocking-fee applicability is explicitly station-dependent: selected AC stations can charge 0.05 EUR/min from minute 241 during 08:00-20:00, and DC time-fee conditions must be resolved per applicable tariff/station. Exact total cost therefore needs station-level surcharge applicability.
DELVP.neededToComplete: Attach the official ad-hoc AC/DC energy tariff only to confirmed LadeVerbundPlus EVSEs and resolve the per-station blocking-fee flag/rule from the app, QR checkout or other official station metadata before declaring complete.

DEMER.reason: Mer officially publishes exact Connect Me prices by power band (0.49 EUR/kWh AC <=49 kW, 0.57 EUR/kWh DC 50-75 kW, 0.69 EUR/kWh HPC 76-400 kW) and states no blocking fee, but ad-hoc prices are only published as maxima and can vary by station. Maxima cannot be used as exact station tariffs.
DEMER.neededToComplete: Apply the exact Connect Me app tariff by validated connector power band and resolve every station/EVSE ad-hoc tariff from Mer's station/payment surface or equivalent official station-level feed.

DEQRM.reason: Public web/API discovery is implemented, but tariff-to-EVSE mapping is not yet exhaustive and station prices can vary.
DEQRM.neededToComplete: Resolve an exact public tariff endpoint or equivalent verifiable mapping for every DEQRM EVSE.

DEQWC.reason: Public web/API discovery is implemented, but tariff-to-EVSE mapping is not yet exhaustive and station prices can vary.
DEQWC.neededToComplete: Resolve an exact public tariff endpoint or equivalent verifiable mapping for every DEQWC EVSE.

DETMO.reason: The official own-network TEAG app tariff is exact and a current energy-volume promotion is modeled, but other payment methods explicitly use the tariff displayed at each station/billing system; those station-level direct prices are not yet mapped exhaustively.
DETMO.neededToComplete: Map the exact ad-hoc/other-payment tariff shown for every DETMO station/EVSE, and enable the V9 billing layer to represent the app promotion exactly (0.49 EUR/kWh for kWh 1-28 then 0.29 EUR/kWh from kWh 29 through 2026-09-30) without flattening it.
